chunks: But those who deny and reject Our signs will belong to Hell, and there abide unchanged.
ai.seo_question: Who are the inhabitants of Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Khuruj min al-Islam* (exit from Islam) through the combination of disbelief (*Kufr*) and denial of signs (*Tadhib*), highlighting that eternal abode in Hell is reserved for those who persist in rejection after clear guidance. It underscores the finality of divine judgment for those who actively oppose the truth, a theme central to the doctrine of *Adl* (Divine Justice) where punishment corresponds to the degree of willful denial.
